'''Batral Orcel''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] son of a wealthy [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] family.

==Biography==
He started aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] before the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] and was a member of the Rebel cell led by [[Card Captor]]. He was later captured and interrogated by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] agents. He refused to tell them anything and was later rescued by Rebel agents.<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
